summary: Backend testing completed for Risk Management & Drawdown Protection System. All 27 tests passed (100%). Fixed a JSON serialization bug where float('inf') values were causing 500 errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed JSON serialization bug: calculate_sortino_ratio() and get_profit_factor() were returning float('inf') which is not JSON serializable. Changed to return 999.99 as a large finite value.
Risk management system correctly tracks: Sharpe ratio, Sortino ratio, max drawdown, current drawdown, win rate, profit factor, Kelly fraction
Position sizing uses Kelly criterion with risk level adjustments (normal=1.0x, elevated=0.75x, high=0.5x, critical=0.25x)
All endpoints return proper JSON responses with expected data structures
seed_data_creation: Test trades recorded during testing (6 trades: 5 wins, 1 loss)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Risk management system is fully functional. Current balance ~$1021 after test trades. Sharpe ratio 4.02, win rate 80%, profit factor 2.35. All risk management endpoints working correctly.

backend_endpoints: GET /api/risk-management/status - Returns balance, drawdown, metrics, risk level ✅
GET /api/risk-management/metrics - Returns Sharpe ratio, Sortino ratio, profit factor, win rate, Kelly fraction ✅
POST /api/risk-management/record-trade - Records trade and updates balance, returns current status ✅
GET /api/risk-management/can-trade - Returns can_trade boolean with reason and recommended position size ✅
GET /api/risk-management/position-size - Returns recommended amount based on Kelly criterion ✅

bug_fixed.issue: JSON serialization error - ValueError: Out of range float values are not JSON compliant
bug_fixed.root_cause: calculate_sortino_ratio() and get_profit_factor() methods returned float('inf') when there were no negative returns or no losses
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Changed float('inf') to 999.99 (large finite value) in both methods
